title: Passengers per flight
statementMd:
Show the five flights with the most bookings: flight id, bookings. Ties by flight id.

Expected columns: `flight_id`, `bookings`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT flight_id, COUNT(*) AS bookings FROM bookings GROUP BY flight_id ORDER BY bookings DESC, flight_id LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
